mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.space_id, c.chunk_no, c.content, c.search_content, c.char_start, c.char_end, c.create_time, c.update_time, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.title, ''), E'\n', c.content) AS embedding_text FROM kb_article_chunk c JOIN kb_article a ON a.id = c.article_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND c.embedding IS NULL ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_article_chunk SET embedding = CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
